description: This file implements the 'PulseAudioSinkType' class and 'PulseAudioSink' class for managing PulseAudio audio sinks, including creation, initialization, volume control, and thread management, within the starboard shared pulse namespace.

classes.name: PulseAudioSink
classes.description: Represents an individual PulseAudio sink, managing audio data writing, volume, and playback state.

classes.name: PulseAudioSinkType
classes.description: Manages the PulseAudio context, mainloop, and creation/destruction of PulseAudioSink instances.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new PulseAudioSink instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PulseAudio context and mainloop, and starts the audio thread.

methods.name: BelongToAudioThread
methods.description: Checks if current thread is the audio thread.

methods.name: CreateNewStream
methods.description: Creates a new PulseAudio stream with specified sample spec and buffer attributes.

methods.name: StateCallback
methods.description: Callback for PulseAudio context state changes.

methods.name: ThreadEntryPoint
methods.description: Entry point for the PulseAudio thread, runs the audio processing loop.

methods.name: AudioThreadFunc
methods.description: Main loop for processing audio data in the PulseAudio thread.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate; supports only 0.0 (pause) and 1.0 (play).

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up PulseAudio context, connects to server, and starts the thread.
